# Feature: Thief — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #35 (Thief) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: Flees from you, steals a key, and drops it at its burrow. Unique: harms your inventory, not your position or run. Useful: an enemy worth avoiding even though it cannot kill you. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** flees from you, steals a key, and drops it at its burrow.

**So that** an enemy worth avoiding even though it cannot kill you.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Thief for the first time in its teaching room (mech-35-thief-room). Teaching moment: First room: you carry a key across an open room the thief crosses. A player who walks straight at it has the key snatched and watches it carried to a burrow they had not noticed, which teaches both that the key can be recovered and where the thief is trying to go. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It moves one tile per player move away from you and is not lethal
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: If it starts a move next to you it snatches your most recent key, carried visibly, then runs for its burrow tile and drops the key there where you can pick it back up
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Corner it and touch it before it reaches the burrow and it drops the key where it stands

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Thief's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-35-thief-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #35.
